summary: Comprehensive backend API testing for MK Capital Markets Technologies (CCMI) corporate site. 24/24 pytest tests passed covering root, site stats, articles (list/filter/search/detail/404), global search (with min-length guard), contact forms (all 6 types + invalid), newsletter (valid, upsert, invalid email), investor access (demo codes MKCMT2026 & INVESTOR-DEMO grant tokens; missing code returns pending), and NDA. All endpoints reachable via REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL /api prefix.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('shutdown'); consider migrating to lifespan handlers (non-blocking, cosmetic).
ARTICLES / SEARCHABLE are in-memory seed data; documented as mocked CMS per PRD — fine for MVP but flag if persistence is expected later.
CORS allow_origins pulled from env with default '*' — acceptable for staging; tighten for prod.
Investor access token is stored but there is no TTL / expiry logic; /investors/verify accepts any stored token indefinitely.
test_credentials: Investor demo codes verified working: MKCMT2026, INVESTOR-DEMO (both return status=granted with token). DUBAI not explicitly tested but same code path.
seed_data_creation: Test rows created via API (TEST_ prefixed) in: contact_submissions (8 rows), newsletter_subs (2 rows), investor_sessions (2 rows), investor_requests (1 row), nda_requests (1 row). No cleanup performed — safe to leave for future regression runs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green. Pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_backend.py is the regression suite — run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_backend.py -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml. When frontend testing is requested, verify integration with these endpoints from https://ccmi-capital-tech.preview.emergentagent.com. Demo access codes MKCMT2026 / INVESTOR-DEMO / DUBAI.
